segments.text: Hello guys, welcome to Tutorly.
So in today's video, I'm going to show you exactly how to create a Clawed AI account.
This process is beginner friendly, and you don't need any technical experience to get started.
To get started, open your preferred web browser and go to the Clawed website by typing
clod.ai into the address bar.
Once the site loads, you'll be taken to the main signup page, where the account creation
process is very straightforward.
Make sure you're visiting the correct official website before entering any personal information.
At this point, you'll usually see two main options for getting started.
The first option is to enter your email address to create a new account manually.
If you choose this method, simply type your email into the field provided and continue
to the next part of the signup process.
It's a good idea to use an email address you can access immediately, because you may need
it for verification or account recovery later.
This is a good option if you prefer using a separate login specifically for this platform.
It can also be helpful if you want to keep your Clawed account separate from your Google
account, or use a dedicated email for AI tools.
The second option is to continue with your Google account.
This can be faster and more convenient, especially if you want to skip the extra steps of confirming
your email address and creating a separate password.
Using Google Sign-In can also make it easier to access Clawed later without remembering
another set of login details.
If you select Google Sign-In, just choose the account you want to use and follow the on-screen
prompts to approve access and continue.
Before confirming, check that you've selected the correct Google account, especially if you're
signed into several personal, school, or work accounts in the same browser.
After that, the site may ask you to select a few options as part of setting up your account.
These prompts can vary slightly, but in general, just read each screen carefully and choose the
option that best matches your needs.
Then continue through the account creation process by following the instructions shown on the
page.
You may be asked about how you plan to use Clawed or to review certain account terms before
continuing.
If you're using email sign-up instead of Google, this is also the stage where you may be asked
to verify your email or finish setting your login details.
Open your email inbox, look for the verification message, and follow the instructions inside
it.
You can see the message, check your spam or junk folder as well.
Take your time during this part and make sure the information you enter is correct.
That helps avoid login issues later and makes the process smoother overall.
In particular, double check your email spelling and store your login information securely so
you can easily access the account again.
Also, if a confirmation message doesn't appear right away, give the page a moment to load
before clicking again, since some sign-up pages can take a few seconds to respond.
Quickly clicking the same button may create confusion, so wait briefly and check whether
the next page opens before trying again.
Once you complete the setup steps, your Clawed AI account will be ready to use.
From there, you can start exploring the platform and using its features right away.
For example, you can ask questions, summarize information, brainstorm ideas, draft content, study
new topics, or get help organizing a project.
And that's it.
As you can see, creating a Clawed AI account is quick and simple, whether you choose to
sign up with your email address or continue with Google.
If you follow the prompts on the screen carefully, you should be able to finish the process in
just a few minutes.
Once you're signed in, you can start a new chat and begin exploring what Clawed AI can help
you accomplish.
